decisions.reason: Recruiting healthcare and hospitality staff is far from the core maritime business and shows no results, so the option is weak, but it reuses the existing crewing infrastructure at low carrying cost and its value remains uncertain.
Superyacht crew recruitment draws on the core crewing network at little extra cost, and its demand is still uncertain enough that keeping the option is worthwhile.
The Smart Academy's partner network is growing quickly to six institutions, a positive early resolution that justifies further commitment.
FuelEU Maritime monitoring is a regulatory necessity the firm has already delivered for all its vessels, so its value is clearly being realized.
The dashboard is integrated into the PAL software, costs little to keep, and supports the growing FuelEU compliance demand.
The cost simulator is a low-cost embedded software feature whose value grows as FuelEU penalties phase in, so the option is worth holding.
